chapter.name: Vibhuti Yoga
chapter.description: Krishna reveals His divine manifestations and opulences (vibhutis), explaining how everything in the universe reflects His greatness. This chapter emphasizes recognizing God in all aspects of creation.
chapter.theme: Understanding the divine manifestations and recognizing God's presence in all things
chapter.yogaType: Vibhuti Yoga - Yoga of Divine Manifestations

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: श्रीभगवानुवाच | भूय एव महाबाहो शृणु मे परमं वचः | यत्तेऽहं प्रीयमाणाय वक्ष्यामि हितकाम्यया ||
verses.transliteration: śrī-bhagavān uvāca | bhūya eva mahā-bāho śṛṇu me paramaṃ vacaḥ | yat te 'haṃ prīyamāṇāya vakṣyāmi hita-kāmyayā ||
verses.english_translation: The Blessed Lord said: Hear again My supreme words, spoken for your benefit.
verses.meaning: Krishna continues His teaching out of compassion.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: न मे विदुः सुरगणाः प्रभवं न महर्षयः | अहमादिर्हि देवानां महर्षीणां च सर्वशः ||
verses.transliteration: na me viduḥ sura-gaṇāḥ prabhavaṃ na maharṣayaḥ | aham ādir hi devānāṃ maharṣīṇāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Neither gods nor sages know My origin; I am their source.
verses.meaning: Krishna is the ultimate origin of all.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: यो मामजमनादिं च वेत्ति लोकमहेश्वरम् | असम्मूढः स मर्त्येषु सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते ||
verses.transliteration: yo mām ajam anādiṃ ca vetti loka-maheśvaram | asammūḍhaḥ sa martyeṣu sarva-pāpaiḥ pramucyate ||
verses.english_translation: One who knows Me as unborn and eternal is freed from all sins.
verses.meaning: Understanding divine nature leads to liberation.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: बुद्धिर्ज्ञानमसम्मोहः क्षमा सत्यं दमः शमः | सुखं दुःखं भवोऽभावो भयं चाभयमेव च ||
verses.transliteration: buddhir jñānam asammohaḥ kṣamā satyaṃ damaḥ śamaḥ | sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhavo 'bhāvo bhayaṃ cābhayam eva ca ||
verses.english_translation: Intelligence, knowledge, clarity, forgiveness, truth, control, joy, sorrow—all come from Me.
verses.meaning: All qualities originate from the divine.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: अहिंसा समता तुष्टिस्तपो दानं यशोऽयशः | भवन्ति भावा भूतानां मत्त एव पृथग्विधाः ||
verses.transliteration: ahiṃsā samatā tuṣṭis tapo dānaṃ yaśo 'yaśaḥ | bhavanti bhāvā bhūtānāṃ matta eva pṛthag-vidhāḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Nonviolence, equality, satisfaction, austerity, and charity all arise from Me.
verses.meaning: All moral and emotional states come from God.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: महर्षयः सप्त पूर्वे चत्वारो मनवस्तथा | मद्भावा मानसा जाता येषां लोक इमाः प्रजाः ||
verses.transliteration: maharṣayaḥ sapta pūrve catvāro manavas tathā | mad-bhāvā mānasā jātā yeṣāṃ loka imāḥ prajāḥ ||
verses.english_translation: The great sages and Manus were born from My mind, and from them all beings descend.
verses.meaning: Creation originates from divine will.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: एतां विभूतिं योगं च मम यो वेत्ति तत्त्वतः | सोऽविकम्पेन योगेन युज्यते नात्र संशयः ||
verses.transliteration: etāṃ vibhūtiṃ yogaṃ ca mama yo vetti tattvataḥ | so 'vikampena yogena yujyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
verses.english_translation: One who understands My divine glories becomes firmly united with Me.
verses.meaning: Knowing God's greatness strengthens devotion.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: अहं सर्वस्य प्रभवो मत्तः सर्वं प्रवर्तते | इति मत्वा भजन्ते मां बुधा भावसमन्विताः ||
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ sarvasya prabhavo mattaḥ sarvaṃ pravartate | iti matvā bhajante māṃ budhā bhāva-samanvitāḥ ||
verses.english_translation: I am the source of everything; the wise worship Me with devotion.
verses.meaning: Understanding origin leads to devotion.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: मच्चित्ता मद्गतप्राणा बोधयन्तः परस्परम् | कथयन्तश्च मां नित्यं तुष्यन्ति च रमन्ति च ||
verses.transliteration: mac-cittā mad-gata-prāṇā bodhayantaḥ parasparam | kathayantaś ca māṃ nityaṃ tuṣyanti ca ramanti ca ||
verses.english_translation: Devotees speak about Me and rejoice in Me constantly.
verses.meaning: Devotion brings joy and connection.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: तेषां सततयुक्तानां भजतां प्रीतिपूर्वकम् | ददामि बुद्धियोगं तं येन मामुपयान्ति ते ||
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ satata-yuktānāṃ bhajatāṃ prīti-pūrvakam | dadāmi buddhi-yogaṃ taṃ yena mām upayānti te ||
verses.english_translation: To those devoted, I give the wisdom to reach Me.
verses.meaning: God guides sincere seekers.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: तेषामेवानुकम्पार्थमहमज्ञानजं तमः | नाशयाम्यात्मभावस्थो ज्ञानदीपेन भास्वता ||
verses.transliteration: teṣām evānukampārtham aham ajñāna-jaṃ tamaḥ | nāśayāmy ātma-bhāva-stho jñāna-dīpena bhāsvatā ||
verses.english_translation: Out of compassion, I destroy ignorance with the light of knowledge.
verses.meaning: Divine grace removes ignorance.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाच | परं ब्रह्म परं धाम पवित्रं परमं भवान् | पुरुषं शाश्वतं दिव्यमादिदेवमजं विभुम् ||
verses.transliteration: arjuna uvāca | paraṃ brahma paraṃ dhāma pavitraṃ paramaṃ bhavān | puruṣaṃ śāśvataṃ divyam ādi-devam ajaṃ vibhum ||
verses.english_translation: Arjuna said: You are the supreme Brahman, the ultimate abode, and the eternal divine person.
verses.meaning: Arjuna recognizes Krishna’s supreme nature.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit: आहुस्त्वामृषयः सर्वे देवर्षिर्नारदस्तथा | असितो देवलो व्यासः स्वयं चैव ब्रवीषि मे ||
verses.transliteration: āhus tvām ṛṣayaḥ sarve devarṣir nāradas tathā | asito devalo vyāsaḥ svayaṃ caiva bravīṣi me ||
verses.english_translation: All sages like Narada and Vyasa declare this truth.
verses.meaning: Spiritual authorities confirm Krishna’s divinity.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit: सर्वमेतदृतं मन्ये यन्मां वदसि केशव | न हि ते भगवन्व्यक्तिं विदुर्देवा न दानवाः ||
verses.transliteration: sarvam etad ṛtaṃ manye yan māṃ vadasi keśava | na hi te bhagavan vyaktiṃ vidur devā na dānavāḥ ||
verses.english_translation: I accept everything You say as truth; even gods do not know Your reality.
verses.meaning: Krishna’s nature is beyond comprehension.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit: स्वयमेवात्मनात्मानं वेत्थ त्वं पुरुषोत्तम | भूतभावन भूतेश देवदेव जगत्पते ||
verses.transliteration: svayam evātmanātmānaṃ vettha tvaṃ puruṣottama | bhūta-bhāvana bhūteśa deva-deva jagat-pate ||
verses.english_translation: Only You know Yourself fully, O Supreme Lord.
verses.meaning: The divine is self-revealing and beyond full human understanding.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit: वक्तुमर्हस्यशेषेण दिव्या ह्यात्मविभूतयः | याभिर्विभूतिभिर्लोकानिमांस्त्वं व्याप्य तिष्ठसि ||
verses.transliteration: vaktum arhasy aśeṣeṇa divyā hy ātma-vibhūtayaḥ | yābhir vibhūtibhir lokān imāṃs tvaṃ vyāpya tiṣṭhasi ||
verses.english_translation: Please describe Your divine glories by which You pervade all worlds.
verses.meaning: Arjuna asks Krishna to explain His manifestations.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit: कथं विद्यामहं योगिंस्त्वां सदा परिचिन्तयन् | केषु केषु च भावेषु चिन्त्योऽसि भगवन्मया ||
verses.transliteration: kathaṃ vidyām ahaṃ yogins tvāṃ sadā paricintayan | keṣu keṣu ca bhāveṣu cintyo 'si bhagavan mayā ||
verses.english_translation: How should I meditate on You, and in what forms should I think of You?
verses.meaning: Arjuna seeks practical ways to remember God.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit: विस्तरेणात्मनो योगं विभूतिं च जनार्दन | भूयः कथय तृप्तिर्हि शृण्वतो नास्ति मेऽमृतम् ||
verses.transliteration: vistareṇātmano yogaṃ vibhūtiṃ ca janārdana | bhūyaḥ kathaya tṛptir hi śṛṇvato nāsti me 'mṛtam ||
verses.english_translation: Explain Your glories again in detail, for I am never satisfied hearing them.
verses.meaning: Divine knowledge brings continuous joy.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: श्रीभगवानुवाच | हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि दिव्या ह्यात्मविभूतयः | प्राधान्यतः कुरुश्रेष्ठ नास्त्यन्तो विस्तरस्य मे ||
verses.transliteration: śrī-bhagavān uvāca | hanta te kathayiṣyāmi divyā hy ātma-vibhūtayaḥ | prādhānyataḥ kuru-śreṣṭha nāsty anto vistarasya me ||
verses.english_translation: I will describe My divine glories, though there is no end to them.
verses.meaning: Krishna begins listing His manifestations.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: अहमात्मा गुडाकेश सर्वभूताशयस्थितः | अहमादिश्च मध्यं च भूतानामन्त एव च ||
verses.transliteration: aham ātmā guḍākeśa sarva-bhūtāśaya-sthitaḥ | aham ādiś ca madhyaṃ ca bhūtānām anta eva ca ||
verses.english_translation: I am the Self seated in all beings; I am the beginning, middle, and end.
verses.meaning: Krishna is present in all existence.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: आदित्यानामहं विष्णुर्ज्योतिषां रविरंशुमान् | मरीचिर्मरुतामस्मि नक्षत्राणामहं शशी ||
verses.transliteration: ādityānām ahaṃ viṣṇur jyotiṣāṃ ravir aṃśumān | marīcir marutām asmi nakṣatrāṇām ahaṃ śaśī ||
verses.english_translation: Among the Adityas I am Vishnu, among lights the sun, among stars the moon.
verses.meaning: Krishna is the greatest among all categories.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: वेदानां सामवेदोऽस्मि देवानामस्मि वासवः | इन्द्रियाणां मनश्चास्मि भूतानामस्मि चेतना ||
verses.transliteration: vedānāṃ sāma-vedo 'smi devānām asmi vāsavaḥ | indriyāṇāṃ manaś cāsmi bhūtānām asmi cetanā ||
verses.english_translation: Among the Vedas I am Sama Veda, among gods I am Indra, among senses I am the mind.
verses.meaning: Krishna is the essence of all systems.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: रुद्राणां शङ्करश्चास्मि वित्तेशो यक्षरक्षसाम् | वसूनां पावकश्चास्मि मेरुः शिखरिणामहम् ||
verses.transliteration: rudrāṇāṃ śaṅkaraś cāsmi vitteśo yakṣa-rakṣasām | vasūnāṃ pāvakaś cāsmi meruḥ śikhariṇām aham ||
verses.english_translation: Among Rudras I am Shiva, among mountains I am Meru.
verses.meaning: Krishna identifies with the greatest forms.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: पुरोधसां च मुख्यं मां विद्धि पार्थ बृहस्पतिम् | सेनानीनामहं स्कन्दः सरसामस्मि सागरः ||
verses.transliteration: purodhasāṃ ca mukhyaṃ māṃ viddhi pārtha bṛhaspatim | senānīnām ahaṃ skandaḥ sarasām asmi sāgaraḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Among priests I am Brihaspati, among generals I am Skanda, among waters I am the ocean.
verses.meaning: Krishna is present in all powerful forms.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: महर्षीणां भृगुरहं गिरामस्म्येकमक्षरम् | यज्ञानां जपयज्ञोऽस्मि स्थावराणां हिमालयः ||
verses.transliteration: maharṣīṇāṃ bhṛgur ahaṃ girām asmy ekam akṣaram | yajñānāṃ japa-yajño 'smi sthāvarāṇāṃ himālayaḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Among sages I am Bhrigu, among sacrifices I am chanting, among mountains the Himalayas.
verses.meaning: Krishna is the essence of greatness.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: अश्वत्थः सर्ववृक्षाणां देवर्षीणां च नारदः | गन्धर्वाणां चित्ररथः सिद्धानां कपिलो मुनिः ||
verses.transliteration: aśvatthaḥ sarva-vṛkṣāṇāṃ devarṣīṇāṃ ca nāradaḥ | gandharvāṇāṃ citrarathaḥ siddhānāṃ kapilo muniḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Among trees I am the Ashvattha, among sages Narada.
verses.meaning: Krishna is the best among all beings.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: उच्चैःश्रवसमश्वानां विद्धि माममृतोद्भवम् | ऐरावतं गजेन्द्राणां नराणां च नराधिपम् ||
verses.transliteration: uccaiḥśravasam aśvānāṃ viddhi mām amṛtodbhavam | airāvataṃ gajendrāṇāṃ narāṇāṃ ca narādhipam ||
verses.english_translation: Among horses I am Uccaiḥśravas, among elephants Airavata, among men the king.
verses.meaning: Krishna represents supreme excellence.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: आयुधानामहं वज्रं धेनूनामस्मि कामधुक् | प्रजनश्चास्मि कन्दर्पः सर्पाणामस्मि वासुकिः ||
verses.transliteration: āyudhānām ahaṃ vajraṃ dhenūnām asmi kāmadhuk | prajanaś cāsmi kandarpaḥ sarpāṇām asmi vāsukiḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Among weapons I am the thunderbolt, among cows the wish-fulfilling cow.
verses.meaning: Krishna is the power behind all forces.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: अनन्तश्चास्मि नागानां वरुणो यादसामहम् | पितॄणामर्यमा चास्मि यमः संयमतामहम् ||
verses.transliteration: anantaś cāsmi nāgānāṃ varuṇo yādasām aham | pitṝṇām aryamā cāsmi yamaḥ saṃyamatām aham ||
verses.english_translation: Among serpents I am Ananta, among waters Varuna, among ancestors Aryama.
verses.meaning: Krishna pervades all domains.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: प्रह्लादश्चास्मि दैत्यानां कालः कलयतामहम् | मृगाणां च मृगेन्द्रोऽहं वैनतेयश्च पक्षिणाम् ||
verses.transliteration: prahlādaś cāsmi daityānāṃ kālaḥ kalayatām aham | mṛgāṇāṃ ca mṛgendro 'haṃ vainateyaś ca pakṣiṇām ||
verses.english_translation: Among demons I am Prahlada, among beasts the lion, among birds Garuda.
verses.meaning: Krishna is the highest in every category.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: पवनः पवतामस्मि रामः शस्त्रभृतामहम् | झषाणां मकरश्चास्मि स्रोतसामस्मि जाह्नवी ||
verses.transliteration: pavanaḥ pavatām asmi rāmaḥ śastra-bhṛtām aham | jhaṣāṇāṃ makaraś cāsmi srotasām asmi jāhnavī ||
verses.english_translation: Among purifiers I am the wind; among warriors I am Rama; among rivers I am the Ganges.
verses.meaning: Krishna identifies with the purest and most powerful forms.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: सर्गाणामादिरन्तश्च मध्यं चैवाहमर्जुन | अध्यात्मविद्या विद्यानां वादः प्रवदतामहम् ||
verses.transliteration: sargāṇām ādir antaś ca madhyaṃ caivāham arjuna | adhyātma-vidyā vidyānāṃ vādaḥ pravadatām aham ||
verses.english_translation: I am the beginning, middle, and end of creation; among knowledge I am spiritual wisdom.
verses.meaning: Krishna is the essence of existence and knowledge.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: अक्षराणामकारोऽस्मि द्वन्द्वः सामासिकस्य च | अहमेवाक्षयः कालो धाताहं विश्वतोमुखः ||
verses.transliteration: akṣarāṇām akāro 'smi dvandvaḥ sāmāsikasya ca | aham evākṣayaḥ kālo dhātāhaṃ viśvato-mukhaḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Among letters I am 'A'; I am eternal time and the sustainer.
verses.meaning: Krishna represents fundamental principles.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: मृत्युः सर्वहरश्चाहमुद्भवश्च भविष्यताम् | कीर्तिः श्रीर्वाक्च नारीणां स्मृतिर्मेधा धृतिः क्षमा ||
verses.transliteration: mṛtyuḥ sarva-haraś cāham udbhavaś ca bhaviṣyatām | kīrtiḥ śrīr vāk ca nārīṇāṃ smṛtir medhā dhṛtiḥ kṣamā ||
verses.english_translation: I am death and the source of future beings; among women I am fame, prosperity, speech, memory, intelligence, firmness, and patience.
verses.meaning: Krishna is both creation and destruction.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: बृहत्साम तथा साम्नां गायत्री छन्दसामहम् | मासानां मार्गशीर्षोऽहमृतूनां कुसुमाकरः ||
verses.transliteration: bṛhat-sāma tathā sāmnāṃ gāyatrī chandasām aham | māsānāṃ mārgaśīrṣo 'ham ṛtūnāṃ kusumākaraḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Among hymns I am Brihat-Sama; among meters I am Gayatri; among months I am Margashirsha; among seasons I am spring.
verses.meaning: Krishna is present in all cycles of time and art.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: द्यूतं छलयतामस्मि तेजस्तेजस्विनामहम् | जयोऽस्मि व्यवसायोऽस्मि सत्त्वं सत्त्ववतामहम् ||
verses.transliteration: dyūtaṃ chalayatām asmi tejas tejasvinām aham | jayo 'smi vyavasāyo 'smi sattvaṃ sattvavatām aham ||
verses.english_translation: Among deceivers I am gambling; among the powerful I am power; I am victory and determination.
verses.meaning: Krishna is the force behind all actions and qualities.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: वृष्णीनां वासुदेवोऽस्मि पाण्डवानां धनञ्जयः | मुनीनामप्यहं व्यासः कवीनामुशनाकविः ||
verses.transliteration: vṛṣṇīnām vāsudevo 'smi pāṇḍavānāṃ dhanañjayaḥ | munīnām apy ahaṃ vyāsaḥ kavīnām uśanā kaviḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Among the Vrishnis I am Vasudeva; among the Pandavas I am Arjuna; among sages I am Vyasa.
verses.meaning: Krishna is present in great personalities.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: दण्डो दमयतामस्मि नीतिरस्मि जिगीषताम् | मौनं चैवास्मि गुह्यानां ज्ञानं ज्ञानवतामहम् ||
verses.transliteration: daṇḍo damayatām asmi nītir asmi jigīṣatām | maunaṃ caivāsmi guhyānāṃ jñānaṃ jñānavatām aham ||
verses.english_translation: I am discipline, policy, silence, and knowledge.
verses.meaning: Krishna is the essence of order and wisdom.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: यच्चापि सर्वभूतानां बीजं तदहमर्जुन | न तदस्ति विना यत्स्यान्मया भूतं चराचरम् ||
verses.transliteration: yac cāpi sarva-bhūtānāṃ bījaṃ tad aham arjuna | na tad asti vinā yat syān mayā bhūtaṃ carācaram ||
verses.english_translation: I am the seed of all beings; nothing exists without Me.
verses.meaning: Krishna is the source of all life.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: नान्तोऽस्ति मम दिव्यानां विभूतीनां परन्तप | एष तूद्देशतः प्रोक्तो विभूतेर्विस्तरो मया ||
verses.transliteration: nānto 'sti mama divyānāṃ vibhūtīnāṃ parantapa | eṣa tūddeśataḥ prokto vibhūter vistaro mayā ||
verses.english_translation: There is no end to My divine glories; what I have said is only a brief description.
verses.meaning: Krishna’s greatness is infinite.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: यद्यद्विभूतिमत्सत्त्वं श्रीमदूर्जितमेव वा | तत्तदेवावगच्छ त्वं मम तेजोंऽशसम्भवम् ||
verses.transliteration: yad yad vibhūtimat sattvaṃ śrīmad ūrjitam eva vā | tat tad evāvagaccha tvaṃ mama tejo-'ṃśa-sambhavam ||
verses.english_translation: Whatever is glorious or powerful comes from a fraction of My splendor.
verses.meaning: All greatness reflects divine power.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: अथवा बहुनैतेन किं ज्ञातेन तवार्जुन | विष्टभ्याहमिदं कृत्स्नमेकांशेन स्थितो जगत् ||
verses.transliteration: athavā bahunaitena kiṃ jñātena tavārjuna | viṣṭabhyāham idaṃ kṛtsnam ekāṃśena sthito jagat ||
verses.english_translation: What need is there for all this detail? I sustain the universe with a single part of Myself.
verses.meaning: Krishna’s power is beyond full description.
